· The Module substat blacklist is a hard filter by default: a Module matching any blacklisted stat takes no part in the loadout. With "Blacklist as zero weight" enabled it is no longer a hard filter, and blacklisted stats score 0 in the Module Top-K ranking
· Cartridges are not affected by the substat blacklist
· The set and the Cartridge main stat are hard filters
· Cartridge/Module substats are priorities, not hard filters
· Order mode first uses the deepest candidate pool of the leading prefix; when a combination has no solution it relaxes one layer at a time, and finally falls back to the full candidate pool
· When priorities tie, equipment matching more of the selected substats is preferred
· The minimum effective level only controls which equipment uses substat priorities
· No score tier limit does not cancel the set or the Cartridge main stat, and does not change the blacklist's current filtering or zero-weight semantics
